$comment: workflow-kit's openrouter node strategy imports llm_kit (REQUIRED: the node dispatches its model declaration through llm_kit.dispatch.declaration.run and needs llm-kit >= 0.1.5; a schema-typed artifact is checked with llm_kit.completion.contract.OutputContract and llm_kit.schema.json_schema and needs llm-kit >= 0.1.3). The edge is declared here so the owning plugin is installed rather than assumed present; an absent or too-old llm-kit is refused at the node runner, the artifact checker and the compiler's schema check. bootstrap_lib is REQUIRED too: the loader validates every model: declaration with bootstrap_lib.model_declaration.parse and CORE_IDS, first shipped in bootstrap 0.129.0. Every compiled openrouter node records execution events: scripts/openrouter_run.py --events calls bootstrap_lib.execution_event.Emitter and JsonlSink(mode="truncate"), first shipped in bootstrap 0.135.0, and passes the Emitter as run(observer=...), first shipped in llm-kit 0.1.5. A node that provides a typed artifact also records its contract event: scripts/openrouter_run.py --provides --events and scripts/check_artifact.py --events call bootstrap_lib.execution_event.Emitter(..., schema="plugins-kit.execution-event/v3"), first shipped in bootstrap 0.137.0. An agent step's model: accepts {id, effort} entries through bootstrap_lib.model_declaration.parse_entries and EFFORT_LEVELS, first shipped in bootstrap 0.150.0, which sets requires_bootstrap.
